_howto: Production Pay tours. steps = page tour. sections = one tour per screen (first visit) plus pop-up form tours (overlay, offered the first time). Guides are in piecework_guides.json. Never reuse a step id.
title: Production Pay tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Production Pay
steps.text:
Pay people for what they produce: set up your farms and units, teams and activities with their rates, give teams tasks, then check each day's production and commit it to payroll.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All Production Pay screens
steps.text: Every screen is listed here. A good order to set up in: Production Settings, Teams, Activities & Pricing, then Tasks.

steps.title: Production Dashboard
steps.text: Today at a glance: production per team and activity, its value, open tasks, days still to commit to payroll, and job costing.

steps.title: Field Maps
steps.text: Where production was captured, on a map of your farms and units.

steps.title: Teams
steps.text: Your production teams, their members and their manager. These are separate from Employee Master's Custom Teams.

steps.title: Activities & Pricing
steps.text: What people are paid for (for example picking, per bin) and the rate for each, with a dated price history.

steps.title: Tasks
steps.text: Give a team or a phone user work to do: which activities, on which farm and units, and the target.

steps.title: Daily Production
steps.text: Check each team's day: quantities captured on the phones, their clockings and pay, then commit it to payroll.

steps.title: Job Costing
steps.text: Time people clocked against jobs on the mobile app, with running and flagged jobs.

steps.title: Production Reports
steps.text: Production, pay and job costing reports, for printing or Excel.

steps.title: Production Settings
steps.text: Farms and units with their GPS boundaries, and the rules that apply to everyone.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Refresh Data
steps.text: Reloads everything on this page, for example after phones have synced new production.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Type what you're looking for, like daily production or pricing, to jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Launchpad
steps.text: Back to your home screen with all your modules.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Switch between dark and light. Your choice follows your login to any computer.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, what's new, and hands-on how-to guides such as setting up farms, creating a team, or adding an activity with its rate.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Which day
steps.text: Pick a day, or step back and forward with the arrows. Today jumps back to today.

steps.title: The day in five numbers
steps.text: People who captured production and how many entries, the piece value at worker rates, open and overdue tasks, team-days not yet committed to payroll, and job costing jobs running or flagged. Click a card to open its screen.

steps.title: Production per team
steps.text: Each team's people, entries and value, and whether the day is Committed to payroll. Open takes you to that team's Daily Production grid for the day.

steps.title: Open tasks
steps.text: Tasks that have started and aren't completed, soonest due first, with how far along they are. Overdue ones are marked.

steps.title: Waiting to be committed
steps.text: Every team-day in the last 14 days with production not yet committed to payroll. Click Open to check and commit it.

steps.title: Two tabs
steps.text: Farms & Units: where the work happens. Global Production: rules that apply to everyone.

steps.title: Add a farm
steps.text: Type the farm's name, set its location with the map pin button, then Add. The location lets the phones and Field Maps know where each farm is.

steps.title: Add a field unit
steps.text: Units are the blocks, orchards or fields on a farm. Choose the farm, name the unit, add its size in hectares and its location, then Add.

steps.title: Your farms and units
steps.text: Edit a name or size in place, change a map boundary, or deactivate a farm or unit. Tick Show Inactive to see deactivated ones.

steps.title: Employees in more than one team
steps.text: When ticked, adding someone to a team keeps them in their other teams. Otherwise they move.

steps.title: Ignore overtime
steps.text: All clocked hours count as normal time, and the overtime columns are hidden in Daily Production. Employee Costs still shows the overtime hours as TNA does, but pays them at the normal rate.

steps.title: Deduct piecework hours
steps.text: When ticked, hours spent on piecework come off normal time. When not ticked, people earn their full normal time as well as their piecework pay.

steps.title: Global Hourly Rate
steps.text: When ticked, this rate replaces every employee's own hourly rate in Production Pay, from the date you choose: in Daily Production and the wage reports. Their Employee Master rates are not changed.

steps.title: Job costing departments
steps.text: Where the mobile app's job list comes from when someone clocks into a job: your T&A departments, your farms and units, farming departments, or your own custom list (managed just below).

steps.title: Save Global Settings
steps.text: Nothing on this tab applies until you save it.

steps.title: Payroll periods
steps.text: Payroll periods and locking are now set up in Employee Master › Payroll Periods. It's the same list, and a locked period can no longer be changed in Daily Production.

steps.title: Teams
steps.text: Your active teams, and those you've deactivated.

steps.title: Create a team
steps.text: Name the team, add any asset tags (for example the tractor or trailer it uses), and choose how the manager is paid on team work. Then Create Team.

steps.title: How the manager is paid on team work
steps.text:
When a team is paid as a team, the quantity is shared among the workers who clocked in:
• Neither ticked: the manager is paid for the team's full quantity.
• Manager Equal Share: the manager gets an equal share, like a worker.
• Manager Average Only: the manager gets the workers' average share.

steps.title: Your teams
steps.text: Each card shows the team's manager and members. Click a card to add or remove members, choose the manager, rename it, see its history, or deactivate it.

steps.title: Import Teams
steps.text: Create teams and assign people in bulk from a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Transfer Employee
steps.text: Move someone from one team to another in one step. The move is recorded in both teams' history.

steps.title: Add Activity
steps.text: What people are paid for, the unit it's counted in (for example bins or trees), and the rate per unit for workers and for managers.

steps.title: Job Costing Activity
steps.text: A job for the Job Costing clock on the mobile app, such as Irrigation or Maintenance. Time is recorded against it; it has no unit or rate.

steps.title: Three lists
steps.text: Active piecework activities, Deactivated ones, and your Job Costing Activities.

steps.title: Each activity
steps.text: Its current worker and manager rate. Pricing Ledger keeps every rate with the date it started, so past days are paid at the rate that applied then. You can also edit or deactivate it.

steps.title: Create Task
steps.text: Give work to a team or a phone user: which activities and how much, on which farm and units, how they're paid, what evidence the phone must collect, and the dates.

steps.title: Active and completed
steps.text: Active Tasks are pending or in progress. Completed Tasks are finished.

steps.title: Each task
steps.text: Where it is, the activities, who it's assigned to, Individual or Team pay, its dates, and a progress bar of what's been captured against the target. Click a task to see its details and everything captured for it.

steps.title: From start to finish
steps.text: A task starts as Pending: you can still edit or delete it. Start puts it In Progress. Complete moves it to Completed Tasks once the work is done.

steps.title: Older and newer
steps.text: Move through the list, newest first.

steps.title: The day
steps.text: Pick the day, or step through days with the arrows. The grid reloads for the team you've chosen.

steps.title: The team
steps.text: Choose the team, then Load Grid. Each team's day is checked and committed on its own.

steps.title: Import Data and Import History
steps.text: Import Data brings in production from an Excel sheet: you match its columns, it's validated, then imported. Import History lists past imports, and one can be rolled back if nothing in it has been committed.

steps.title: Export Excel
steps.text: The grid on screen, as a spreadsheet.

steps.title: The grid
steps.text: One row per team member. Their shift and clockings from Time & Attendance, a column per task activity with their quantities and times, then their hours and wages: normal, approved and potential overtime, Sunday/public holiday, piece wage and the total.

steps.title: Check, then commit
steps.text:
Save Draft keeps your changes. Commit to Payroll makes the day final: its records lock. Unlock reopens committed records, and Revert Edits puts back what the phones captured.

If the day falls in a locked payroll period (Employee Master › Payroll Periods), it can't be saved, committed, unlocked or reverted until that period is unlocked. You'll see who and which dates are affected.

steps.title: Date range
steps.text: Choose the dates and click Load Data. Export saves what's on screen to Excel.

steps.title: The totals
steps.text:
Total hours, how many people and jobs, jobs still running, and flagged jobs.

A job is flagged when it ran over 14 hours or has no activity chosen. A job still running has no clock-out yet.

steps.title: Find what you need
steps.text: Search by name or PIN, choose a department, or click Flagged Only to see just the jobs that need checking.

steps.title: Jobs per person
steps.text: Click a person to open their jobs: the unit, the activity, when it started and ended, how long, and who captured it. Use Edit to correct the unit or activity on a job.

steps.title: Where the job list comes from
steps.text: The activities people clock into are the Job Costing Activities under Activities & Pricing. The departments or units come from the setting in Production Settings.

steps.title: Dates
steps.text: The date range for the report.

steps.title: Narrow it down
steps.text: Filter by department, team, task, or pick particular employees. Leave them on All for everyone.

steps.title: Report Type
steps.text:
• Daily Detailed: each person's production per day.
• Employee Daily Evidence: the photos captured with it.
• Employee Summary and Activity Summary: totals for the date range, per person or per activity.
• Job Costing (by employee), Job Costing Summary (a matrix of people and jobs) and Job Costing Wages (hours × hourly rate per day; the Global Hourly Rate applies here when it's switched on).
• Global Summary: everything combined.

steps.title: Sort
steps.text: Order by name, PIN or quantity. Tick Ignore Letters in PIN Sort to sort PINs by their numbers only.

steps.title: Generate Report
steps.text: Shows the report on screen. Export to Excel at the top saves it as a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Which day
steps.text: Choose the day to show.

steps.title: Teams and tasks
steps.text: Choose which teams and tasks to show. The number shows how many you've picked.

steps.title: Plot Activities
steps.text: Puts every capture on the map where it was made, over your farms and units. Click a pin to see who captured what, when, and any photo.

steps.title: Save Default View
steps.text: Move and zoom the map to your farms, then save it. The map opens there next time.
